rubric.description: Investigates negative vendor AP $7,882.69 using invoices, credits and payments; its sign does not establish a prepaid asset. Other balances total $21,380.00.
Excludes the $9,000.00 vendor invoice already paid on October 27 (Purchase 12071) from month-end accrued expenses.
Derives invoice candidates $122,095.61 versus ending accrued GL $123,692.61 and retains unexplained inherited $1,597.00; candidate totals are not a final supported close balance.
Admits vendor invoices containing 'email the payment confirmation to' remittance instructions and separates non-P&L patent accruals so unpaid patent invoices do not distort Investing cash outflows.
Requires formula-based subledger totals, source period review and an actual separate review receipt; an assigned reviewer remains pending rather than fabricated as complete.
